questions.text: What fraction of Earth's surface is covered by water?
What is Earth's average surface temperature?
What would Earth's average temperature be WITHOUT the natural greenhouse effect?
Which planet has a runaway greenhouse effect and is the hottest in the Solar System?
Why is liquid water essential for life on Earth?
options: It acts as a universal solvent for chemical reactions and transports nutrients
It is rare in the universe
questions.correct: It acts as a universal solvent for chemical reactions and transports nutrients

questions.text: What layer of the atmosphere contains the ozone layer that protects us from UV radiation?
What generates Earth's protective magnetic field?
Why is Earth's distance from the Sun called the 'Goldilocks zone'?
options: It's not too hot and not too cold — just right for liquid water
It's the closest planet to the Sun
It matches the color of gold
questions.correct: It's not too hot and not too cold — just right for liquid water

questions.text: Which planet is closest to Earth in size and is often called its 'sister planet'?
Why does ice float on water, and why is this important for life?
options: Ice is less dense than water and insulates the water below, letting aquatic life survive winter
Floating ice has no effect on life
questions.correct: Ice is less dense than water and insulates the water below, letting aquatic life survive winter

questions.text: What is the greenhouse effect?
options: Gases in the atmosphere trap infrared radiation, warming Earth's surface
Cooling of the atmosphere by clouds
questions.correct: Gases in the atmosphere trap infrared radiation, warming Earth's surface

questions.text: What kind of radiation do greenhouse gases absorb?
Which greenhouse gas is the MOST abundant naturally in Earth's atmosphere?
Which human activity is the MAIN source of carbon dioxide emissions?
options: Burning fossil fuels for electricity and transportation
questions.correct: Burning fossil fuels for electricity and transportation

questions.text: Approximately how much more potent is methane (CH₄) at trapping heat than carbon dioxide?
What is the DIFFERENCE between the natural and enhanced greenhouse effect?
options: Natural is caused by naturally occurring GHGs; enhanced is caused by human-added GHGs
Natural is bad, enhanced is good
Natural only happens in the tropics
questions.correct: Natural is caused by naturally occurring GHGs; enhanced is caused by human-added GHGs

_tag.rationale: compare natural vs enhanced greenhouse effect

questions.text: Roughly what percentage of incoming sunlight is reflected back to space by clouds, ice, and bright surfaces (albedo)?
Why is the Philippines considered highly vulnerable to climate change even though it emits little CO₂?
options: It's an archipelago in the typhoon belt with thousands of coastal communities
It burns the most fossil fuels
questions.correct: It's an archipelago in the typhoon belt with thousands of coastal communities

questions.text: Which gas has the HIGHEST global warming potential per molecule among the following?
Why does sunlight pass through the atmosphere more easily than heat can escape?
options: Sunlight is visible light (short wavelength, not absorbed well by GHGs); heat is infrared (long wavelength, absorbed by GHGs)
questions.correct: Sunlight is visible light (short wavelength, not absorbed well by GHGs); heat is infrared (long wavelength, absorbed by GHGs)
